```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Rat Ketogenic vs Control Diet Gene Expression Analysis

# 1. Load the dataset
rat_dataset <- read.table("Data/05_rat_KD.txt", header=TRUE, row.names=1)
cat("Dataset dimensions (genes x samples):", dim(rat_dataset), "\n")
head(rat_dataset)

# 2. Log2 transformation
log2_rat_dataset <- log2(rat_dataset + 1)  

# Separate columns by diet
control_cols <- grep("control.diet", colnames(rat_dataset), value=TRUE)
keto_cols <- grep("ketogenic.diet", colnames(rat_dataset), value=TRUE)

# 3. Student's t-test to check if the mean expression differs between diet groups
t_test_pvalues <- apply(log2_rat_dataset, 1, function(gene_expr){
  t.test(as.numeric(gene_expr[control_cols]),
         as.numeric(gene_expr[keto_cols]), var.equal=TRUE)$p.value
})

# 4. Histogram of p-values and Bonferroni correction
hist(t_test_pvalues, breaks=50, col="skyblue",
     main="Histogram of p-values from t-tests",
     xlab="p-value", ylab="Frequency")
p_0.05 <- sum(t_test_pvalues < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)
p_0.01 <- sum(t_test_pvalues < 0.01, na.rm=TRUE)
cat("Probesets with p < 0.05:", p_0.05, "\n")
cat("Probesets with p < 0.01:", p_0.01, "\n")
bonferroni_alpha <- 0.05 / length(t_test_pvalues)
cat("Bonferroni-corrected alpha:", bonferroni_alpha, "\n")

# 5. Calculate mean expression and fold changes to quantify magnitude of expression difference 
keto_log2_mean <- rowMeans(log2_rat_dataset[, keto_cols], na.rm=TRUE)
control_log2_mean <- rowMeans(log2_rat_dataset[, control_cols], na.rm=TRUE)
log2_fold_change <- keto_log2_mean - control_log2_mean
fold_change <- 2 ^ log2_fold_change

# Display basic stats
cat("Max fold change:", max(fold_change), " Min fold change:", min(fold_change), "\n")

# 6. Identify significant genes based on Bonferroni-significant p-value & fold change 
sig_index <- which(t_test_pvalues < bonferroni_alpha & abs(log2_fold_change) > 1)
significant_genes <- rownames(log2_rat_dataset)[sig_index]
cat("Significant genes:\n")
print(significant_genes)

# 7. Visualise summary combining fold change magnitude and statistical significance using volcano plot
log10_pvalues <- -log10(t_test_pvalues)
plot(log2_fold_change, log10_pvalues, pch=20, col="grey",
     xlab="Log2 Fold Change", ylab="-Log10 p-value",
     main="Volcano Plot: Ketogenic vs Control Diet")
abline(v=c(-1,1), col="blue", lty=2)           # Fold change threshold ±1 (log2 scale)
abline(h=-log10(0.05), col="red", lty=2)      # p-value threshold 0.05
points(log2_fold_change[sig_index], log10_pvalues[sig_index], col="red", pch=20)
